title: Enable the online menu when Steam connects
setup: The main menu enables Online Play when Steam connects and keeps Local Play available when it disconnects. Set `STEAM_APP_ID` to the ID used to [launch your game](/steam/setup#launch-with-an-appid).
code:
extends Control

const STEAM_APP_ID: int = 480
const ONLINE_CHECK_SECONDS: float = 1.0

@export var online_button: Button
@export var status_label: Label

var _steam: SteamClient
var _online_timer: Timer


func _ready() -> void:
    online_button.disabled = true
    _steam = SteamClient.boot(self, STEAM_APP_ID)
    if _steam == null:
        status_label.text = "Online play unavailable."
        return
    if not _steam.is_ready():
        status_label.text = "Steam startup failed. Local play is available."
        push_warning(_steam.get_initialization_error())
        return

    _online_timer = Timer.new()
    _online_timer.wait_time = ONLINE_CHECK_SECONDS
    _online_timer.timeout.connect(_update_online_menu)
    add_child(_online_timer)
    _steam.runtime_lost.connect(_disable_online_menu)
    _online_timer.start()
    _update_online_menu()


func _update_online_menu() -> void:
    var online: bool = _steam.is_online()
    online_button.disabled = not online
    status_label.text = "Online play ready." if online else "Steam offline. Local play is available."


func _disable_online_menu() -> void:
    _online_timer.stop()
    online_button.disabled = true
    status_label.text = "Steam closed. Local play is available."

title: Host a two-player game for Steam friends
setup: Press Host to open a two-player arena with one seat available to Steam friends and invitees. The [Steam hosting guide](/steam/listen-servers) shows how to configure the host.

title: Join the first public arena with room for a player
setup: Press Find game to join the first public arena with a free seat. The search uses the [game's Steam provider and lobby namespace](/steam/listen-servers#find-an-open-game).

title: Invite a friend to the arena from the pause menu
setup: From the host's pause menu, press Invite friends to open Steam's invitation picker for the [active arena lobby](/steam/listen-servers#invite-and-join).

title: Open the player's achievements from the pause menu
setup: Press Achievements in the pause menu to open this game's achievement pane. [Enable the Steam Overlay](/steam/testing#check-the-overlay-and-achievements) before testing.

title: Update Steam progression after a match victory
setup: After a match victory, update the player's lifetime win count and unlock the first-win achievement using [keys published in Steamworks](/steam/client-services#record-progression). The victory screen reports whether Steam accepted the update.

title: Resume a campaign at the last saved Steam Cloud checkpoint
setup: Reaching a campaign checkpoint saves its ID to [Steam Cloud](/steam/client-services#save-a-profile-to-cloud). Press Continue to resume from the last saved checkpoint.

title: Show subscribed Workshop maps in the custom map browser
setup: Press Refresh in Custom Maps to load titles for maps the player subscribes to in Steam Workshop. Selecting a map passes its published ID to the game.

title: Open a Steam practice room and show who joins
setup: Press Create room in the Practice menu, then invite friends through the Steam Overlay. The [social lobby](/steam/listen-servers#run-a-social-lobby-without-a-game) updates the roster as players join or leave.
